_source: Ines's LinkedIn newsletter 'Art, XR & Impact Opportunities', editions 12 (2026-03-03), 13 (2026-03-30), 14 (2026-04-20), 15 (2026-06-02), 17 (2026-06-29). Scraped 2026-09-08.

new.title: WomenTech Global Awards 2026
new.desc: Celebrate and amplify the people shaping the future of technology. Nominate yourself or someone who inspires you across dozens of categories. Winners announced December 3, 2026. A great visibility boost for women in XR and emerging tech.

new.title: AWE 2027 — Call for Speakers & Early Opportunities
new.desc: Opportunities for AWE USA 2027 (Long Beach) are already open, including the call for speakers and showcase tracks. If you want to present, demo, or exhibit at the world's biggest XR conference, getting in early is the move.

new.title: TED × POSCA Global Artist Residency — "Visible Mending"
new.desc: A distributed residency from TED and POSCA, curated by Fine Acts. Four artists each receive $15,000 to develop community-rooted public interventions on the theme of repair, resilience, and "visible mending," inspired by kintsugi. Projects run through 2027.

new.title: VH AWARD (7th Edition) — Emerging Media Artists Engaged with Asia
new.desc: Hyundai Motor Group's global award for emerging media artists of Asian descent, based in Asia, or of the Asian diaspora, working in audiovisual and screen-based art. Five finalists receive a production grant and an online residency developed with Ars Electronica; the Grand Prix winner gets an additional $30,000.

new.title: UNESCO Youth for Peace — Intercultural Leadership Programme
new.desc: UNESCO's flagship leadership initiative, with a 2026 theme on human connection and dialogue in the age of AI. 50 selected leaders aged 25–45 receive $10,000 in seed funding for a community initiative, plus training, mentorship, and a global alumni network.

new.title: NEW INC — New Museum Incubator (Year 13)
new.desc: The first museum-led incubator, run by the New Museum in New York. Members join a focus track (including Extended Realities, Art & Code, and Creative Science) for a year of mentorship, professional development, workspace, and community.

new.title: Global Good Fund Fellowship 2027
new.desc: A $10,000 leadership development grant plus one-on-one executive coaching, mentorship, and a global network for social entrepreneurs leading mission-driven enterprises. The fellowship invests in you as a leader, not just your organization.

new.title: ISO Immersive Media Fund — Indigenous Creators
new.desc: $500,000 CAD fund supporting Indigenous XR storytellers (Native American, Alaska Native, and Native Hawaiian artists based in the US), presented with Agog.

new.title: AWS She Builds Mentorship Program 2026
new.desc: A free 12-week mentorship experience for women in technology, pairing you with a dedicated AWS mentor matched to your goals, location, and experience. Includes a global cohort community and events with senior AWS leaders.

new.title: Global Innovation Challenge 2026 — Social Shifters
new.desc: Multiple grant awards of up to $15,000 USD for young changemakers (18–30, worldwide) solving social and environmental problems. Open to early-stage ideas and existing projects alike; finalists join a global community with mentorship and resources.

new.title: Climate Change AI — Summer School 2026
new.desc: A virtual summer school exploring the intersection of climate change and AI, with lectures, tutorials, and hands-on sessions. Registration is $10 for most economies and open to newcomers to the field.

new.title: Agog Open Call 2026 — Climate Futures + Immersive Media
new.desc: Up to $1 million in total grants for projects using immersive media to engage people on climate — from awareness to action. A huge one for the XR + climate community.

new.title: Galaxy XR Launchpad — $100K to Build Your First Pilot
new.desc: Samsung × Rock Paper Reality selects one team and funds a full pilot — $100,000 in RPR build services plus a Samsung Galaxy XR headset, in a two-month sprint to build and ship. Open to teams in the USA, UK, and Canada.

new.title: Jackson Wild × Hollywood Climate Summit Awards 2026
new.desc: Nature film's equivalent of the Oscars, expanded in 2026 into scripted formats including narrative film, TV, video games, digital media, and podcasts, in partnership with Hollywood Climate Summit.

new.title: Third Wave Fund Artist-in-Residence 2026
new.desc: Fully paid residency for artists committed to gender justice and collective liberation — all disciplines welcome. Emphasis on a "by-and-for" model: artists embedded in the communities and movements they represent.

new.title: Museum of Immersivism — The Internet Show
new.desc: The Museum of Immersivism is accepting submissions for a new exhibit about what people think of the internet. Any medium welcome — visual art, video, sound, 3D, mixed media. Free to submit; no AI-generated work.

new.title: UNESCO SDG 4 — Good Practices Open Call
new.desc: UNESCO is seeking good practices advancing SDG 4 — inclusive, equitable quality education and lifelong learning. Selected practices are featured in the SDG 4 Knowledge Hub and shared globally.

new.title: Creativity Pioneers Fund 2026
new.desc: €5,000 unrestricted micro-grants for nonprofits placing creativity at the core of social transformation, especially those serving youth aged 16–27. Selected organizations also join a global network with mentorship and visibility.

new.title: UNESCO International Fund for Cultural Diversity (IFCD) 2026
new.desc: Up to $100,000 for 12–24 month projects strengthening cultural and creative sectors in developing countries, focused on policy development and institutional capacity building.

new.title: XR Women Museum — Garden: In Full Bloom
new.desc: A virtual XR exhibition turning the entire XR Women Museum into a living garden. Immersive works across XR, AR, AI, virtual worlds, 3D sculpture, video, animation, sound, and experimental forms.

new.title: Blue Ridge Labs Founder Fellowship 2026
new.desc: 20-week venture-building fellowship from idea to MVP, backed by Robin Hood Foundation. About 25 founders advance to an in-person phase in Brooklyn with a $20,000 stipend, mentorship, and MVP development support.

new.title: PHI Immersive Residency — XR for Impact
new.desc: A 4-week intensive residency at PHI Studio in Montreal developing a new immersive XR project, with tailored creative, technical, and strategic support. Open to artists and collectives residing in North America.

new.title: PHI Montréal Residency 2026
new.desc: Collaborative residency to develop a public engagement project with PHI, in partnership with CALQ. Selected projects receive $13,000 CAD. For one artist residing in Montreal and one in Quebec outside Greater Montreal.

new.title: NatGeo × Nature Conservancy Marine Conservation Externship
new.desc: 8-week, part-time, fully remote externship for ages 18–25 exploring marine conservation challenges and community-based solutions. $500 stipend upon successful completion; no prior conservation experience required.

new.title: Stanford Venture Fellowship 2026
new.desc: Only 10 fellows selected worldwide for a fully funded one-week immersive experience inside the Stanford and Silicon Valley ecosystem — sessions, workshops, and direct access to founders, faculty, and researchers.

new.title: National Geographic × The Climate Pledge — Storytelling RFP
new.desc: NatGeo and The Climate Pledge are funding a global portfolio of climate resilience and solutions stories. Grants up to $100,000 for storytellers, journalists, filmmakers, and explorers.

new.title: Immensiva Residency 2026 — Collective Cartographies
new.desc: The world's first residency for artists working with VR, AR, and AI, at ESPRONCEDA in Barcelona. The 2026 theme: transforming heritage into shared multiuser experiences. Teams retain full IP rights.

new.title: XR Women Awards 2026 — Nominations
new.desc: Know a woman shaping the future of XR? Nominate her — or yourself. The award made for the XR Women community, presented at AWE USA 2026.

new.title: UNESCO Prize for Girls' and Women's Education 2026
new.desc: A $50,000 prize honoring outstanding and innovative contributions to advancing girls' and women's education. Nominations via governments and UNESCO partner organizations.
